title: Rooms Owner Revoke — payload
description: A room's owner asks their own agent to withdraw credentials the room issued: sign the room's next revocation list as the room, keep it, and deliver it to each host serving the room.

roomId.description: The room whose credentials are withdrawn. The recipient signs as this room.

signingKeyId.description: Which held key signs as the room — named explicitly, as for rooms/owner/issue-authority, because nothing maps a DID to the key it was minted with. A key that is not one the room's DID document lists for `assertionMethod` produces a list every host refuses.

hosts.description: Every host serving the room, as DIDs: its primary, any mirror, and a host it is moving to. A withdrawal binds only the hosts that hold it, so a host left off this list honours what the room withdrew.

withdraw.description: What to withdraw now. Absent or empty: sign nothing new, and deliver the list the recipient holds — how a host the room has moved to, or one that missed a delivery, is brought up to date.

reason.description: Why, for the owner's own record. Never put into the list, which reaches every host: it MUST NOT carry personal data or a credential.

Withdrawal.title: Withdrawal
Withdrawal.description: One withdrawal to add, discriminated by `kind` as a RevocationEntry is. It carries no `revokedAt`: the recipient stamps the time it signs, so that a subject or room entry withdraws exactly what the room had issued until then and nothing the caller dated.

until.description: OPTIONAL. The credential's own `validUntil`, after which the entry can be dropped.

subject.description: The party withdrawn: every credential naming them as subject or issuer that the room's chain gave them before now. Never the room.

until.description: OPTIONAL. When the last credential the room issued them expires, after which the entry can be dropped.
OPTIONAL. When the last credential the room issued before now expires.

Delivery.title: Delivery
Delivery.description: What one host did with the list.

outcome.description: `accepted`: the host holds this list, or answered it as a repeat, and enforces it from `inForceAt`. `refused`: it answered and declined; its code is in `code`. `unreachable`: no answer, so the outcome is unknown — repeat the request with no `withdraw` to deliver again.

head.description: The head the host answered with. Present when `accepted`.

inForceAt.description: When the host began enforcing the list. Present when `accepted`.

code.description: The host's error code. Present when `refused`.

Response.title: Rooms Owner Revoke — response payload
Response.description: Success response to rooms/owner/revoke. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/rooms/owner/revoke/0.1#response. The list the recipient now holds for the room, and what each host did with it. A success says the list was signed and kept; only a delivery whose outcome is `accepted` says a host enforces it.

list.description: The room's current list, as signed. Returned so the owner holds a copy that does not depend on the recipient.

deliveries.description: One per host in the request, in its order.
